mod config files, loaded and reloaded (`native_register_configs`, `native_config_loading`,
`native_config_reloading`, `native_config_unloading`; `native_configs.rs`).
doc_summary: mod config files, loaded and reloaded (`ModConfigEvent`). `native_register_configs` lists a mod's configs: `NativeConfig::new(mod_id, kind, default)`, a file `config/<mod id>-<kind>.toml` (`.file(..)` names another inside `config/`) written from `default` when missing. `Client` configs load on the window when the game starts, `Common` once per process (the window, or a dedicated server), `Server` on the server before `native_server_about_to_start` for each world, read from the world's `serverconfig/<file>` when there is one. `native_config_loading` hands over the file's text (`NativeConfigFile`: mod id, kind, file, path, text); the mod parses it, and checks `mod_id`, since every mod hears every config. The game looks at the files' modification times once a second and fires `native_config_reloading` with changed text; the same text saved again fires nothing. `native_config_unloading` drops a server's configs when it stops. Bundles need "hooks": @API:mod_configs@.
